Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Contabilitate și Servicii financiare
Yokogawa, award winner for ‘Best Asset Monitoring Technology’ and ‘Best Digital Twin Technology’ at the HP Awards, is a leading provider of industrial automation, test and measurement, information systems and industrial services in several industries.
 Our aim is to shape a better future for our planet through supporting the energy transition, (bio)technology, artificial intelligence, industrial cybersecurity, etc. We are committed to the United Nations sustainable development goals by utilizing our ability to measure and connect.
 Around 18 000 employees work on all five continents with one corporate mission, to “co-innovate tomorrow”.
 We are looking for a dynamic colleague who shares our passion for technology and cares for our planet. In return we offer great opportunities to grow yourself in a truly global enterprise where respect, value creation, collaboration, integrity, taking care of each other, and gratitude is highly valued.
 At Yokogawa Romania, location Bucharest we are looking for a new colleague in the position of: SAP L1.5 Service Desk Engineer 
 As an SAP L1.5 Service Desk Engineer, you will provide operational support for SAP master data processes with a strong focus on Customer and Vendor Registration & Maintenance activities across multiple regions.
 You will act as the first-line support contact for business users, ensuring accurate processing of customer and vendor master data requests while maintaining compliance with internal procedures and data governance standards. In addition, you will provide IT Service Desk support for Microsoft technologies, Active Directory administration, Microsoft Azure services, and end-user support activities.
 Your main responsibilities are: 
Act as an L1.5 support specialist and key point of contact for SAP Customer and Vendor Master Data activities across the organization.
Create, update, extend, block and maintain SAP Customer Master records.
Maintain partner functions including Sold-To, Ship-To, Bill-To and Payer relationships.
Validate customer information and supporting documentation to ensure data quality and compliance.
Create, update, extend, block and maintain SAP Vendor Master records.
Support regional vendor registration processes and maintain purchasing, accounting and payment information.
Validate tax, banking and legal documents for vendor onboarding and maintenance.
Support SAP business users by executing and troubleshooting transactions (T-codes).
Create and manage SAP reports and perform master data analysis when required.
Explain SAP business processes and provide guidance to end users.
Gather business requirements and support continuous process improvement initiatives.
Prepare work instructions, process documentation and knowledge articles.
Manage incidents, service requests and changes using ServiceNow.
Provide L2 support for Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Office applications.
Administer user accounts, groups and permissions using Active Directory and AD Manager.
Support Microsoft Azure administration activities and basic cloud services operations.
 We are looking for a colleague with: 
2-5 years’ experience in SAP support, master data management, Service Desk or application support roles
Hands-on experience with SAP Customer Master Data maintenance.
Hands-on experience with SAP Vendor Master Data maintenance and vendor registration processes.
Good understanding of SAP navigation, SAP GUI and transaction processing.
Experience creating and maintaining reports and extracting business information from SAP.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality and compliance principles.
Experience with ticket management tools such as ServiceNow.
Beginner Experience administering Active Directory using AD Manager.
Knowledge of Microsoft Azure administration and Microsoft 365 services.
Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving and customer service skills.
Excellent communication skills and ability to work with business users.
Attention to detail, accuracy and quality-focused mindset.
Experience documenting procedures and creating knowledge articles.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
Fluent English (written and spoken).
Experience working with ITIL-aligned processes: incident, problem, and change management (ITIL Foundation is a plus)
 Nice to have: 
SAP S/4HANA or SAP MDG exposure.
ITIL Foundation certification.
Experience supporting finance, procurement, customer onboarding or vendor onboarding processes.
Power BI reporting experience.
Microsoft excel intermediate experience. 
 What we promise to offer: 
Freedom to do your job and autonomy is important to us. 
Exciting challenges within a mature organization that demands a high degree of individual responsibility and promotes initiatives. 
A competitive salary and extra benefits.
Innovative and advanced high-technology products and services.
Excellent career opportunities within an international environment.
 Important for us 
 For Yokogawa diversity and inclusion is not just a human resources initiative or social to-do. It is something that we strongly believe and promote. We aim to recruit talent who dare to bring change to our organization with a diverse mindset and refreshing new views.
 Yokogawa wants a Diverse, Equitable, and Inclusive culture. We will actively recruit, develop, and promote people from a variety of backgrounds who differ in terms of experience, knowledge, thinking styles, perspective, cultural background, and socioeconomic status. We will not discriminate based on any categorization of humankind. Yokogawa values differences and enables everyone to belong, contribute, succeed, and demonstrate their full potential.
